provenance.name: anchored-v5
provenance.note: Provisional anchoring to the published results of another machine (round robin 2022/2023, Bosch SMV6ECX51E, eco programme, detergent D; docs/research/standards.md section 7.1), to be replaced by washes on the owner's machine. Made on the water side "spotless-sim 0.5.0 water-6", sources sha256:3ae47724f84751e1ac420c22c4d9a18ef53aa485153eeb3f4253210260c527bf; valid for that water side only (anchors/scripts/check.ts). Reference detergent D at 20 g. soil.egg_yolk.rateRef (and soil.milk.rateRef with it) fitted to the six in-machine egg-yolk rates; the lags read off the same bench data; liq.xProtease fitted to the cutlery and glass class means and soil.bleachRate to the crockery class mean of the record, each through the calibration tool's likelihood of a group mean score. Everything else is the registry's default (the soak of Eco 50 sprayed for prog.soakDuty of the time). soil.bleachRate is kept by the floor rule: at its default every iec_tea item reads dirty, which caps the crockery mean at 3.21 against the published 3.68; the record bounds it from below only (off the floor from 0.0009). See docs/calibration/anchoring-v5.md.

supersededBy.why: the soak of Eco 50 at a duty of 0.5, which the owner's wash 01 contradicts (docs/calibration/owner-wash-01-calibration.md); anchored-v6 was itself replaced by anchored-v7 the same day
